title: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Token-Level Perception-Grounded Advantage Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing frameworks rely on coarse, sequence-level reward signals that lack the fine-grained supervision over the visually-grounded steps within a multimodal reasoning chain. We investigate this gap through the lens of two token-level metrics: visual dependency (i.e. how much a token's prediction relies on the input image features) and predictive entropy. translated_title: 基于Token级感知锚定优势估计的多模态推理强化方法
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已经提升了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的推理能力，然而现有框架依赖于粗粒度的序列级奖励信号，缺乏对多模态推理链中视觉锚定步骤的细粒度监督。我们通过两个token级指标来研究这一差距：视觉依赖性（即一个token的预测在多大程度上依赖于输入图像特征）和预测熵。我们的实证分析揭示了两个关键发现：（1）随着视觉锚定程度的增强，正确的推理链相比错误的推理链表现出显著更急剧的熵下降；（2）关键token（即预测错误会引发推理崩溃的token）是正确推理链导出的视觉依赖性与预测熵联合分布中的统计离群点。受这些发现启发，我们提出了token级感知锚定的优势估计方法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现正确推理链在视觉锚定增强时熵下降更显著、且关键token是视觉依赖与预测熵联合分布中的统计离群点，据此提出token级感知锚定的优势估计方法，为多模态大语言模型推理提供细粒度的强化学习奖励。
en_tdlr: By revealing that pivotal tokens in correct reasoning chains are statistical outliers in the joint distribution of visual dependency and predictive entropy, this paper proposes token-level perception-grounded advantage estimation to provide fine-grained rewards for reinforcing multimodal reasoning in MLLMs.
